note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved; ZInQ.Syntax.Template.denote a definition: Node semantics in stored order, calls, fixed integer expressions, the 22-prime catalogue and psi_component have matching definitions; the fixed point codes (iota_eq_psi_unconditional) and the zero set of the finite guard product (guardPoly_eval_eq_zero_iff) are proved. [F]'s templates are built from formulas rather than stored node lists, so Node.denote is the semantics, not the source of the library.

noncomputable def Template.denote (I : Constructors E) (lib : List ExPoly) (t : Template E) :
    ExPoly :=
  ⟨t.parameterCount, t.variableCount - t.parameterCount,
    getPoly (denoteNodes I lib t.nodes) t.root⟩
